raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Multi-turn RL rollouts resend the earlier turns' already-expanded IDs; expanding them again is wasted work.

## Modifications

- `mm_token_expansion_start_len` on `/generate` and chat requests: the expanded prefix length; only placeholders after it are expanded. A list gives one per prompt, repeated for `n > 1` like `input_ids`.
- Documented in `sampling_params.mdx`.
- Borrows the fix for token-space chat requests from dzorlu (#47400).

## Tests

`test_mm_token_expansion_start_len.py`, chat and call-site tests; the bitwise test sends each new turn partially expanded.

## Stack

Part 9 of 9, based on part 8; review and merge in order.

| Part | PR | Title |
|---|---|---|
| 1/9 | #43420 | Move multimodal enums to a shared module |
| 2/9 | #46408 | Initialize multimodal processors from a processor config |
| 3/9 | #46409 | Extract a shared multimodal processor mixin |
| 4/9 | #46410 | Split feature transport and preprocessing placement out of the base processor |
| 5/9 | #46411 | Add a token-space multimodal processor |
| 6/9 | #46412 | Serve token-space processors behind --enable-token-space-processor |
| 7/9 | #46413 | Add a token-space strategy for Qwen VL models |
| 8/9 | #46414 | Check token-space Qwen output against the legacy processor |
| 9/9 | #46415 | Expand only the new turn of a multimodal request **(this PR)** |

+"""CPU tests for the caller's mm_token_expansion_start_len.
+
+expanded prefix | tokens to expand -> start_len = prefix length in supplied IDs
+positive start_len     -> require non-empty supplied IDs; 0 expands everything
+start_len list         -> one per prompt, repeated for n > 1 like input_ids
+single prompt          -> integer start_len only, whatever n is
+batch / n > 1          -> broadcast a scalar start_len
+text without IDs       -> start_len 0 or omitted; tokenize later
+positive start_len, legacy or no mm processor -> ValueError; token-space -> accepted
+
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import GenerateReqInput
+from sglang.srt.managers.tokenizer_manager import (
+    _reject_unsupported_mm_token_expansion_start_len,
+)
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.qwen_vl import QwenVLImageProcessor
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.token_space_mm_process.sglang import (
+    TokenSpaceSGLangProcessor,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestMMTokenExpansionStartLen(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_batch_and_parallel_sampling_alignment(self):
+        for n, start_lens, expected_start_lens in (
+            (1, 0, [0, 0]),
+            (1, 1, [1, 1]),
+            (1, [1, 3], [1, 3]),
+            (2, 0, [0, 0]),
+            (2, 1, [1, 1]),
+            (2, [1, 3], [1, 3]),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(n=n, start_lens=start_lens):
+                request = GenerateReqInput(
+                    input_ids=[[10, 11], [20, 21, 22]],
+                    mm_token_expansion_start_len=start_lens,
+                    sampling_params={"n": n},
+                )
+                request.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [request[i].mm_token_expansion_start_len for i in range(2 * n)],
+                    expected_start_lens * n,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [request[i].input_ids for i in range(2 * n)],
+                    [[10, 11], [20, 21, 22]] * n,
+                )
+
+        # One prompt sampled twice shares its scalar start_len.
+        request = GenerateReqInput(
+            input_ids=[10, 11],
+            mm_token_expansion_start_len=1,
+            sampling_params={"n": 2},
+        )
+        request.normalize_batch_and_arguments()
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [request[i].mm_token_expansion_start_len for i in range(2)], [1, 1]
+        )
